single_close_claim_race.existing_gap: ProductDispatchJournal has account-scoped entry and PROTECTION_STOP claim streams; _TradingEffectGuard checks ENTRY and initial protection duplication only. No current POSITION_EXIT/EMERGENCY_EXIT duplication guard demonstrated. Distinct action IDs can therefore each reach generic nonentry execute unless added guard.
single_close_claim_race.minimal_api: iter_claimed_closes_for_position(run_id,position_id), covering BOTH POSITION_EXIT and EMERGENCY_EXIT across provider_ref/account_ref and all run_ids, using existing bounded keyset _iter_claim_inventory plus one shared outer generation fence; do not scan only own run or only selected close role.
single_close_claim_race.fence: Capture claim_inventory_generation before both-role scan; require unchanged during/after complete inventory. Existing generation=(PRAGMA data_version,total_changes) fences other connections and own connection. Missing/null scope conservatively denies. Revalidate original read/canonical subject/current process and exact lease.
single_close_claim_race.effect_boundary: Check during preparation/admission and again _TradingEffectGuard.require after durable prepare_and_claim, including provider.request final guard. Exclude exactly current (run_id,operation_id); any other close claim for original same position denies first-slice second close even if new action/revision. Same original operation follows reconcile, never another POST. Do not allow opposite emergency role to bypass ordinary pending claim.
single_close_claim_race.terminal_policy: First bounded implementation may deny every other historical close claim for this original position, avoiding invented settlement permissions. Later residual retries require fresh E5 action/current native residual and explicit proven prior terminal settlement; pending/ambiguous/not-found cannot be treated as absent.
meaningful_regressions: Two different close action IDs same position; POSITION_EXIT vs EMERGENCY_EXIT; cross-run same account scope; late injected competing claim between initial check and final provider guard -> no second POST
Inventory mutation between role pages/roles and same-connection total_changes -> fail closed; same original operation duplicate -> reconcile only
